title:
Listens to 'EDITOR_HEADER_ACTION_CLICK_COPY' on various Summary sections of Data Preparation.
Receives a data path in the payload and copies the value of the data path to the clipboard with the action
object as the key.

One field should be merged into the `payload`:
- `dataPath`: the string array representing the path to the value to be copied to the clipboard.
name: CopyActionValueToClipboard
